model_output.score_comment_short: The internship names relevant tools, but its bullets leave the analytical work thin.
model_output.score_comment_long: The Tableau dashboard and survey data work give the internship a concrete starting point. Most bullets stop before explaining what you analyzed or produced. Add those details to the existing experience section first.
model_output.score_plain: A reviewer can identify your early analytics experience and tools. They may need more detail to compare your work with an analytics opening.
model_output.first_impression: Your credit union internship puts Excel, SQL, and Tableau in a work setting. The bullets are brief enough that the substance of the analysis is difficult to see.
model_output.biggest_gap_example: "Built a dashboard in Tableau for the marketing team" names the tool and audience, but not what the dashboard showed, making its use hard to assess.
model_output.summary: Building a Tableau dashboard for a marketing team is a useful detail because it connects your analytics work to an audience. Alongside survey cleaning and reporting, it places you at the internship level in data analytics while you complete your information degree. The presentation bullet doesn't say what findings you shared, so a reviewer cannot yet see the analytical conclusions you communicated.
strengths: Cleaning member survey data in both Excel and SQL shows where you applied those tools.
Weekly reporting gives the analytics support work a recurring cadence.
Managing the data science club's budget and reimbursements adds a financial responsibility alongside your coursework.
gaps: The dashboard's subject and intended use are absent, leaving its content unclear.
The survey bullet doesn't describe the data problems you handled, so the cleaning work could range from basic formatting to more involved preparation.
The findings presentation doesn't identify its conclusions, leaving the substance of your communication unclear.

top_fixes.fix: In the Tableau dashboard bullet, name the information it displayed and what the marketing team used or intended to use it for.
top_fixes.why: The reader can then understand the work beyond the software and its audience.
